packageRules.description: GitHub Actions version bumps touch .github/workflows/**, which our own AI sweep deliberately refuses to merge (GITHUB_TOKEN can't write workflow files without `workflow` scope). Renovate's own app install already has that permission, and it still waits for our required checks (checks, workflows from pr-checks.yml) to pass before merging -- so this closes the gap without giving the AI bot any extra scope.

The agents' job runs on the Python of the Dockerfile, and the engine (LangGraph needs ormsgpack) does not install on 3.15 yet: with 3.15 on main no agent job could start (2026-10-13, after #316). Hold the image at 3.14 until the engine runs on its own Python or its dependencies support 3.15.
